summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing of the new AI Troubleshooting Assistant (sessions + SSE + context + suggestion). All backend pytest tests passed (4/4). All frontend flows passed end-to-end: /troubleshooting loads with sessions sidebar, Radix computer picker shows live CPU/RAM/Disk strip, SSE streaming renders user bubble -> streaming assistant bubble -> final chat-msg-assistant, hardware-failure prompt produces chat-suggestion with 'Submit maintenance report' button that navigates to /report pre-filled with computer PC-012, problem type "Computer won't turn on", and description. Session reload restores messages, 'New conversation' clears the view, delete-on-hover removes the session. Technician user can access /troubleshooting; regression on /computers, /reports, and /report (no params) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py send_session_message: the SSE generator closes over mutable `history` and `s` captured before the user message is persisted — this is actually correct (we want history WITHOUT the new user message, which is passed separately to stream_reply). No bug, just worth a comment.

server.py line ~795: `asyncio.create_task(producer())` without storing a reference — if the consumer disconnects early, the task is only cancelled by GC. Fine for current scope but consider holding the handle and cancelling on client disconnect.

assistant.py stream_reply: the `holding` branch stops yielding deltas once '<<' is seen, but if the model emits '<<' that is NOT the REPORT marker, the rest of the message is suppressed from the UI (still saved to DB clean). Acceptable given the system prompt constrains output, but a defensive timeout/fallback flush would be safer.
Troubleshooting.jsx: `loadSessions()` is called after every send even on error — fine, but no cleanup/abort on component unmount for the fetch stream (minor memory concern on fast route switches).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed PC-003 (active alerts/telemetry) and PC-012 (no monitoring) for context + suggestion tests. All test sessions created were deleted in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_troubleshoot_assistant.py (run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_troubleshoot_assistant.py -n 0`). Used ~5 LLM calls total (2 in backend test_live_context_and_persistence multi-turn, 1 in test_hardware_problem_produces_suggestion, 1 from frontend hardware-failure prompt). SSE endpoint returns text/event-stream, keepalive comment lines start with ':', data lines are 'data: {json}\n\n'. The GPT-5 reply for the hardware failure prompt consistently produces a valid <<REPORT marker and problem_type "Computer won't turn on". For Radix SelectTrigger values use inner_text or input_value cautiously; sometimes the trigger span renders via portal — screenshot verifies prefill works.
